_readme: TEST CONFIG — used only by the verification scripts under /home/team/shared/execution/scripts.
Mode is approve-before-execution: every order is proposed, shown in full, and the price and
account state are re-read immediately before submission. Never automatic.
meridian-h1-v1 is enabled here ONLY so it can originate a Practice order to exercise the
connection. It is the invented ruleset that both backtests found not tradeable. Every order
it originates is recorded with origin=INVENTED_RULESET_TEST and shown as such on the dashboard.
